name: mcp-cassandra

connectionPoints.description: An array of contact points (IP addresses or hostnames) for the Cassandra cluster.

localDataCenter.description: The name of the local data center.

keyspace.description: Optional default keyspace to use for the connection.

tools.name: cassandra_describe_table
tools.description: Describes a table in a specified Cassandra keyspace, showing its columns, data types, primary key, and table options.

keyspaceName.description: The name of the keyspace containing the table.

tableName.description: The name of the table to describe.

tools.name: cassandra_execute_query
tools.description: Executes a CQL query against the Cassandra cluster.

query.description: The CQL query string to execute.

params.description: Optional array of parameters for the CQL query (for prepared statements).

consistency.description: Optional consistency level (e.g., ONE, LOCAL_QUORUM, QUORUM). Defaults to LOCAL_ONE if not specified.

fetchSize.description: Optional number of rows to fetch per page.

tools.name: cassandra_list_indexes
tools.description: Lists all secondary indexes and materialized views in a Cassandra keyspace, optionally filtered by table.

keyspaceName.description: The name of the keyspace for which to list indexes and views.

tableName.description: Optional table name to filter indexes by base table.

tools.name: cassandra_list_keyspaces
tools.description: Lists all available keyspaces in the Cassandra cluster. System keyspaces can be included optionally.

includeSystemKeyspaces.description: Whether to include system keyspaces in the results (default: false)

tools.name: cassandra_list_tables
tools.description: Lists all tables in a specified Cassandra keyspace. Can optionally include materialized views.

keyspaceName.description: The name of the keyspace for which to list tables.

includeViews.description: Whether to include materialized views in the results (default: false)

tools.name: cassandra_select_rows
tools.description: Selects rows from a Cassandra table with optional filtering, ordering, and limiting.

selectColumns.description: Optional array of column names to select. If omitted, selects all columns ('*').

whereClauses.description: Optional map of column names to values for WHERE clauses. Conditions are ANDed. Example: { "user_id": "123", "status": "active" }

orderBy.description: Optional ordering. Can be a single {column, order} object or an array of them.

limit.description: Optional LIMIT clause for the number of rows to return.

allowFiltering.description: Optional ALLOW FILTERING clause. Use with caution. Defaults to false.

consistency.description: Optional consistency level (e.g., ONE, LOCAL_QUORUM). Defaults to LOCAL_ONE.

fetchSize.description: Optional number of rows to fetch per page.

pageState.description: Optional page state for pagination (hex string).

tools.name: cassandra_show_create_table
tools.description: Shows the CQL 'CREATE TABLE' statement that can be used to recreate the specified table.

keyspaceName.description: The name of the keyspace containing the table.

tableName.description: The name of the table to show creation statement for.
